settings.fieldDescriptions.agent.imageIn.text: Controls how image attachments are sent to the model.

settings.fieldDescriptions.agent.maxTurn.text: Upper bound for tool-calling turns before Hermes stops a run.

settings.fieldDescriptions.approvals.mod.text: How Hermes handles commands that need explicit approval.

settings.fieldDescriptions.approvals.tim.text: How long approval prompts wait before timing out.

settings.fieldDescriptions.auxiliary.com.text: Seconds to wait for the auxiliary compression model per call (default 120). Raise for slow local models.

settings.fieldDescriptions.browser.useRe.text: Local browsing uses your real logins. Hermes copies your default browser's profile (cookies, logins, preferences) into a managed snapshot and drives it with its packaged Chromium — your live profile is never opened directly, and the copy is refreshed from it on each run. Also lets the agent open a local real-profile session on request even when a cloud browser backend is configured. Only Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Brave Origin, Chromium) are supported; a non-Chromium default fails with a clear message. Off by default.

settings.fieldDescriptions.checkpoints.e.text: Create rollback snapshots before file edits.

settings.fieldDescriptions.codeExecution.text: How strictly code execution is scoped to the current project.

settings.fieldDescriptions.compression.c.text: Raise compression to 85% for supported ChatGPT Codex OAuth models.

settings.fieldDescriptions.compression.e.text: Summarize older context when conversations get large.

settings.fieldDescriptions.context.engin.text: Strategy for managing long conversations near the context limit.

settings.fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoS.text: Scan local folders for Git repositories to show in Projects.
Folders and their descendants to skip during repository discovery.
Folders to scan. Leave empty to scan your home directory.

settings.fieldDescriptions.display.perso.text: Default assistant style for new sessions.

settings.fieldDescriptions.display.showR.text: Show reasoning sections when the backend provides them.

settings.fieldDescriptions.fallbackProvi.text: Backup provider:model entries to try if the default model fails.

settings.fieldDescriptions.fileReadMaxCh.text: Maximum characters Hermes can read from one file request.

settings.fieldDescriptions.memory.memory.text: Save durable memories that can help future sessions.

settings.fieldDescriptions.memory.userPr.text: Maintain a compact profile of user preferences.

settings.fieldDescriptions.model.text: Used for new chats unless you pick a different model in the composer.

settings.fieldDescriptions.modelContextL.text: Overrides the detected context window of the MAIN chat model only (tokens). Leave at 0 to use the selected model's detected value. Does not affect auxiliary/MoA models.

settings.fieldDescriptions.security.reda.text: Hide detected secrets from model-visible content when possible.

settings.fieldDescriptions.stt.echoTrans.text: Post the raw 🎙️ transcript of voice messages back to the chat.

settings.fieldDescriptions.stt.elevenlab.text: Optional ISO-639-3 language code. Blank lets ElevenLabs auto-detect.

settings.fieldDescriptions.stt.enabled.text: Enable local or provider-backed speech transcription.

settings.fieldDescriptions.stt.streaming.text: Show text while you speak (OpenAI, xAI, ElevenLabs). Falls back to the recording on any failure.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.cwd.text: Default project folder for tool and terminal work.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.dayt.text: Image used when the execution backend is Daytona.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.dock.text: Container image used when the execution backend is Docker.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.envP.text: Environment variables to pass into tool execution.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.moda.text: Image used when the execution backend is Modal.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.pers.text: SSH backend: keep exported variables between commands. Off starts each command from the login environment; the working directory always carries over.

settings.fieldDescriptions.terminal.sing.text: Image used when the execution backend is Singularity.

settings.fieldDescriptions.timezone.text: IANA timezone identifier. Blank uses the system timezone.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.autoS.text: Let an LLM insert expressive audio tags ([laughing], [sighs]) into the script before synthesis.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.bitRa.text: MP3 bitrate in bps. Only applies when codec is mp3.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.langu.text: Spoken language code (e.g. en, pt-BR) or "auto" for auto-detection.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.optim.text: Latency vs. quality trade-off. 0 = best quality, 2 = lowest latency.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.sampl.text: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger files.

settings.fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.voice.text: xAI voice ID (e.g. eve) or a custom voice ID.

settings.fieldDescriptions.updates.nonIn.text: When Hermes updates itself from the app (no terminal prompt), keep local source edits (stash) or throw them away (discard). Terminal updates always ask.

settings.fieldDescriptions.voice.gptLive.text: Extra sentences for the live voice persona (tone, pace, language). Hermes keeps its own system prompt.
Voice for GPT-Live mode. Custom voice IDs are accepted.

settings.fieldDescriptions.voice.voiceCh.text: chained: speech-to-text → Hermes → text-to-speech with the providers below. gpt-live: one full-duplex OpenAI voice model (gpt-live-1) listens and talks, and hands every real request to Hermes — any model you have selected answers with the full toolset. Needs an OpenAI API key; the voice layer bills $0.05 per minute.
